name: Advantest Corporation
price_source: StockAnalysis.com live quote/market-cap page (TYO:6857), cross-checked vs Yahoo/Google Finance and company IR share count
owner_fcf_base: FY25 reported FCF JPY 300.6B less ~JPY 3B SBC (share-remuneration plans immaterial, <0.3% of revenue) = ~JPY 298B owner FCF base. Net cash ~JPY 340B added to EV.

conservador.note: AI tester demand decelerates post cap-ex peak (not collapse): Ph1 yr1-5 10% CAGR, Ph2 glides 7%->2.5%, g_term 2.5%. WACC 8.8%.

base.note: Sustained AI/HPC SoC tester leadership: Ph1 16% CAGR (vs FY26 guide +25.8% sales), Ph2 glides 10%->3%, g_term 3.0%.

optimista.note: AI supercycle persists, share gains + memory test: Ph1 22% CAGR, Ph2 glides 13%->3.5%, g_term 3.5%.

multiple_rationale: Anchor = 5y-avg fwd P/E 33.5x with NO haircut. Structural change is positive, not deteriorating: Advantest is the dominant AI/HPC SoC ATE supplier; OI margin expanded from ~30% to 44% and FCF/ROE hit records (ROE 57.6%, net cash). The 5y-avg spanned lower-margin years, so 33.5x arguably under-credits the improved franchise. Offsetting that, the stock sits at the top of an AI cap-ex cycle with high cyclicality/beta, so I neither haircut nor add a premium. Applied to a normalized fwd EPS of ~JPY 679 (blend of conservative IR guidance EPS 641.61 at 150 JPY/USD and consensus ~717 at ~161 spot FX) -> iv_multiple JPY 22,761. Current 48.4x = fwd P/E at JPY 32,850 / guidance EPS 641.61 (aggregators show ~45.8x on higher consensus EPS); ~45-48% premium to the 5y avg.
structural_change: POSITIVE structural improvement (not deterioration). Advantest has transitioned from a cyclical ATE vendor to the de-facto monopoly supplier of advanced SoC test systems for AI/HPC chips (NVIDIA-class accelerators, HBM-driven test intensity). Operating margin re-rated from ~30% to ~44%, FY25 sales +44.7%, OI +118.8% to record JPY 499.1B, net income +132.9%, record FCF JPY 300.6B, ROE 57.6%, net cash ~JPY 340B. FY26 guided to another record (+25.8% sales). Main risk is cyclical (AI cap-ex digestion / customer concentration), not franchise erosion. SBC immaterial.
sanity_notes: Price re-verified at JPY 32,850 (StockAnalysis live, Jun 22-23 2026); the JPY 32,170 in the data file is a few days stale on a very fast-moving name (intra-month range JPY 27,325 Jun 12 -> 30,660 Jun 16 -> 32,850 Jun 22). Shares confirmed: 732M issued less 6.48M treasury = ~725.5M ex-treasury (0.7255B); guidance basic EPS JPY 641.61 = NI 465.5B / 725.5M ties out; diluted ~= basic (negligible dilution). Implied mcap = 32,850 x 0.7255B = JPY 23.83T / 161.55 USDJPY = ~USD 147.5B, matching StockAnalysis JPY 23.32T (~USD 144B) -> mcap_sanity_ok TRUE. WACC 8.8% (Japan Rf 1.3% + ERP 5.0% x beta 1.5; elevated beta reflects AI-semis cyclicality). Reconciled IV JPY 17,956 = 0.55*DCF 14,025 + 0.45*multiple 22,761, i.e. ~55% of the current JPY 32,850 price (inside the 30-300% magnitude band, so no units/FX/share error). READ-THROUGH: a top-tier quality compounder, but priced for perfection at the AI cap-ex peak (~45-48x fwd vs 33.5x 5y avg); on owner-earnings the market is discounting many years of sustained 20%+ growth. DCF weighted above multiple (0.55/0.45) given cyclicality and customer concentration. IV well below price -> rich, not a margin-of-safety entry today.
